lines.trans: Nastya, stop being so deeply upset!
It hurts me very much, he broke my heart.
Do you know how many more guys you will still have?
I do not need others, I liked Max.
Is it really worth falling apart over every one?

You are kind, beautiful, and very smart.
Then why did he forget me so quickly?
Because he is a foolish and fickle guy.
I want him to understand his mistake.
Now those are the right thoughts, my friend!
Thank you so much for the warm support.

examples.trans: We have nobody to fear here.

meanings.note: the comparative 'быстрее', often as an order
the comparative 'быстрее', often as an order

examples.text: Виталик, почему мы так медленно едем? Быстрее!
examples.trans: Vitalik, why are we going so slowly? Faster!

meanings.note: the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
present есть; у меня есть = I have

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.

examples.text: Потому что он глупый и ветреный парень.
examples.trans: Because he is a foolish and fickle guy.
All right, here you go. There, look.

meanings.note: Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('stupid, silly, foolish').

examples.text: Ваня, ты глупый? Зачем ты сейчас это при нём сказал?
examples.trans: Vanya, are you stupid? Why did you just say that in front of him?

meanings.note: in greetings: добрый день, добрый вечер

examples.text: Добрый вечер, Вика. С Новым годом!
examples.trans: Good evening, Vika. Happy New Year!

meanings.note: Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('other, another, different').

examples.text: Послушайте, а можно в другое место? Здесь плохо пахнет.
examples.trans: Listen, could we go somewhere else? It smells bad in here.

meanings.note: in threats: ты ещё увидишь = you'll see

examples.text: У тебя же есть ещё. Дай хоть одну.
examples.trans: But you've still got some. Give me just one.

meanings.note: Prefix 'за-' marks beginning an action, covering, or stopping by along the way (stem 'быть'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to forget', paired with 'забывать'.

examples.trans: Don't forget to wash the toilet.

examples.text: Сейчас будешь чинить трубу. И унитаз не забудь помыть.
examples.trans: Now you're going to fix the pipe. And don't forget to wash the toilet.

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.note: emphasis: вот поэтому ты и... = that's exactly why you...

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

examples.text: Из-за вашей Лёли весь класс зовёт меня врунишкой!
examples.trans: Because of your Lyolya the whole class calls me a little liar!
We were late because of the rain.

examples.text: А трава в мешках сгорела. Из-за вас!
examples.trans: And the herbs in the sacks burned. Because of you!

examples.text: Аркаш, мне москвичи звонят каждый день. Может, всё-таки передумаем?
examples.trans: Arkasha, the people from Moscow call me every day. Maybe we should reconsider after all?

meanings.note: Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('beautiful, handsome').

examples.trans: They have a very beautiful house.
An interesting thought occurred to him.

examples.text: У меня была отличная умная мысль.
examples.trans: I had an excellent clever thought.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

examples.text: Неужели так трудно найти хороший сюжет?
examples.trans: Is it really so difficult to find a good story?

examples.text: Неужели президент накажет вас за правду?
examples.trans: Will the president really punish you for the truth?
Do you really not care at all?

meanings.note: the person who likes is in the dative: мне нравится = I like it

examples.trans: The reaction is positive. People like it.

meanings.note: short form 'нужен / нужна / нужно / нужны' + dative: 'мне нужна работа' = I need a job

meanings.en: to cheat, to deceive, to trick

examples.trans: If you cheat us, there'll be trouble.
Listen, if you cheat us, there'll be trouble. Got it?

meanings.note: Adjective formed with the common Slavic suffix '-н-' from a noun/verb root. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('huge, enormous').

examples.text: Кстати, если хочешь, иди к нам в команду. Шансы у нас огромные.
examples.trans: By the way, if you want, join our team. Our chances are huge.

meanings.note: accusative/genitive его (него after prepositions), dative ему (нему)

meanings.en: other forms: его (gen/acc), ему (dat), им (instr), нём (prep)

examples.trans: I love our town very much.

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.
This is some kind of mistake!
There are many serious mistakes in the case.

meanings.note: перестань(те)! = stop it!, oh come on!

examples.text: Да перестаньте! Я двадцать лет в карты не играла.
examples.trans: Oh, stop it! I haven't played cards for twenty years.

examples.text: Иначе я перестану давать тебе деньги!
examples.trans: Otherwise I'll stop giving you money!

meanings.note: Prefix 'под-' ('under, up to') indicates approaching or supporting from below (stem 'держка'). Common feminine noun meaning 'support, backing' in everyday Russian.

examples.trans: There you go! No support at all!
I really need the family's support.

meanings.note: Prefix 'под-' ('under, up to') indicates approaching or supporting from below (stem 'руга'). Common feminine noun meaning 'female friend, girlfriend' in everyday Russian.

examples.trans: I'll invite a female friend over.

examples.text: Пять тысяч рублей. Я подругу приглашу.
examples.trans: Five thousand roubles. I'll invite a female friend over.

meanings.note: понял? = got it?; понял = got it

examples.trans: Share it all equally with everyone, understand?

examples.text: Я устал, потому что много работал.
examples.trans: I'm tired because I worked a lot.
I'm at home because I'm ill.
Why are we going so slowly?

examples.text: Виталик, почему мы так медленно едем? Быстрее!
examples.trans: Vitalik, why are we going so slowly? Faster!
A course of the correct antibiotics.
We have prescribed a course of the correct antibiotics.

разбить.gloss: to break, to smash, to wreck (a car)

meanings.note: Prefix 'раз-' ('apart, un-, thoroughly') indicates distribution or intensive action (stem 'бить'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to break, to smash, to wreck (a car)', paired with 'разбивать'.

examples.trans: Did you wreck the car or what?

examples.text: Это от руля синяк! В какой машине? Ты машину разбил, что ли?
examples.trans: That's a bruise from a steering wheel! In what car? Did you wreck the car or what?

examples.text: Я так вспоминаю. Значит, машину разбил, что ли?
examples.trans: I'm trying to recall it. So I wrecked the car, then?
The car is insured, don't be upset.
And the car is insured, don't be upset.
Alright, come on, don't be upset.

meanings.note: refers back to the subject: 'он держит своё слово' = he keeps his word

examples.text: А что я за мэр такой, который держит своё слово?
examples.trans: And what kind of mayor would I be if I kept my word?

meanings.note: у меня сердце = I have a bad heart (colloquial)

examples.text: Мне горько, мне плохо. У меня сердце.
examples.trans: I feel bitter, I feel awful. I have a bad heart.
The wind is blowing hard outside.

examples.text: Я так два года потеряла. Любила так сильно!
examples.trans: I lost two years like that. I loved him so much!

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'нова').

examples.text: Нормально? Она через неделю снова потечёт!
examples.trans: Fine? It'll be leaking again in a week!

meanings.note: спасибо за + accusative = thank you for

meanings.note: сколько стоит? = how much is it?

examples.trans: And how much does the console cost?

meanings.note: at the start of a question

examples.text: Я тебе тогда сказал: ты меня ещё поцелуешь.
examples.trans: I told you back then: you'll kiss me one day.

убиваться.gloss: to grieve bitterly, to kill oneself (working/worrying)

meanings.en: to grieve deeply, to torment oneself
meanings.note: informal: to fall apart over someone or something

examples.text: Неужели стоит так убиваться из-за каждого?

meanings.note: уже четыре года = for four years now

examples.text: Я уже четыре года работаю мэром.
examples.trans: I've been mayor for four years now.

meanings.note: Prefix 'у-' marks departure, removal, or successful completion (stem 'мный'). Adjective formed with the common Slavic suffix '-н-' from a noun/verb root. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('clever, smart').

examples.text: Ты же у нас такая умная!
Ты же у нас такая умная! Скажи, что сделать, я сделаю.
examples.trans: You're the clever one here! Tell me what to do, and I'll do it.

examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.

examples.trans: I'm calling to say thank you.
So that there are witnesses, Samson.

meanings.note: pointing at a thing or a situation; 'это' + noun = 'this is ...'
points at something: это моё = that's mine

meanings.en: other forms: этого, этому, это, этим, этом

examples.trans: And this is for you. A toy car!

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
